caption: A wheelbarrow full of soil is pushed from a paved patio onto a soft lawn, and its wheel sinks into the turf and drags.

sa.check: A wheelbarrow full of soil is pushed along a paved patio.
It is pushed onto a lawn.
Its wheel sinks into the turf.
The barrow is full of soil.
The paving comes first, then the lawn, then the sinking.

pc.expect: On the paving the wheel rolls without sinking; on the lawn it sinks and leaves a track, and the change happens at the edge of the paving.
pc.fail: The wheel sinks into the paving; or it rolls over the lawn leaving no track as if on stone; or it sinks well before or well after the edge of the paving.

pc.expect: The barrow slows as the wheel sinks and drags.
pc.fail: The barrow speeds up on the soft lawn; or it glides across the lawn as freely as it did on the paving; or it stops dead at the edge of the paving as though against a wall.

pc.expect: The barrow stays down on its wheel and legs, and the load rides in the tray.
pc.fail: The barrow lifts off the ground; or soil rises out of the tray; or the wheel floats above the turf.

pc.expect: The soil in the tray shifts and settles as the barrow jolts, and turf disturbed by the wheel stays on the ground.
pc.fail: The load stays a rigid block while the barrow jolts; or soil rises away from the tray and hangs; or the turf flows like liquid around the wheel.

pc.expect: One barrow with its load keeps its number and shape.
pc.fail: The barrow vanishes or a second one appears; or the wheel passes through the ground; or the barrow turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The barrow's colour, the paving and the lawn stay the same.
pc.fail: The barrow changes colour; or the edge between paving and lawn moves between frames; or the garden behind rearranges.
